messages:
jia: Quick heads-up: onboarding llama5 via bridge-convert into ptq-int4. Small but reproducible summary quality drop vs fp32 on news-sum. Repro steps below.

jia: Repro:
```
python convert/bridge_convert.py --src llama5 --out ./llama5-bridge/ --quant ptq-int4 --group 128
./eval/harness --model ./llama5-bridge/ --task news-sum --seed 13 --batch 8
```

sam: Numbers?

jia: Rouge-L ~ -4.8, hallucination rate up ~10% -> 2%. Perplexity +0.6.

oliver: Likely suspects: angle/inv_freq scaling or head-dim reorder. Any per-head diffs?

jia: Dumped layer2 inv_freq: heads 4 & 10 show scale ~1.0007 vs fp32. Tiny but consistent.

natalie: Tiny angle offsets can amplify autoregressively. Run a logits ddiff float vs quant for first 100 tokens and per-head L2.

jia: Launched: `./tools/logit_diff --ref ./models/llama5-fp32 --alt ./llama5-bridge/ --len 100 --out /tmp/dd.json`

ci-bot: CI queued job 9754321000-quant-audit.

ci-bot: Job finished. Divergence begins ~token 11; top-5 mismatch 4%->17% by token 35. Heads 4 & 10 highest L2.

sam: Try converter ablations: group sizes 64/128/256, per-tensor vs per-channel, and a conversion patch that multiplies inv_freq by 0.9993.

jia: Quick patch applied: inv_freq *= 0.9993 and re-ran smoke eval. Result: Rouge-L gap down to ~1.1, hallucinations ~3.5%. Group-size 64 helps but less than inv_freq tweak.

natalie: Action items: add inv_freq sanity check in converter (warn if per-head dev >5e-4), auto-correct option, and a 10-sample smoke eval in CI for new converts. I'll file MLD-3502 and assign.

oliver: If auto-correct becomes common, we should add per-model rotary metadata in model catalog to avoid heuristics.

sam: I'll PR the converter tests + CI smoke. ETA tomorrow EOD.

ci-bot: Closing job 9754321000-quant-audit (artifacts: /ci/artifacts/9754321000/).
